'''Praetoria Vonil''' was an offensive style of [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] developed by the [[Imperial Knight]]s that focused on moving quickly and striking hard with one's [[Imperial Knight lightsaber|lightsaber]]. Like the more defensive [[Praetoria Ishu]], it was unique to the Imperial Knights, and placed greater emphasis on teamwork than on one's individual prowess.<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
